Petitioner no.1 undertakes to continue depositing Rs.2,000/- per month as aforementioned.
A Demand Draft bearing no.160847 dated 03.02.2024 for Rs.3,00,000/-, drawn on Indian Bank, Kirti Nagar Branch, New Delhi, in the name of respondent no.2, has been handed over to respondent no.2.
